name: Miracle
overview: Join Bear Grylls to explore true stories of the impossible in this supernatural series, where moments of divine intervention challenge logic, science, and skepticism. Each episode combines gripping firsthand accounts, cinematic reenactments, and expert analysis to uncover moments that defy explanation. Featuring exclusive music videos from acclaimed Christian artists like Natalie Grant, Phil Wickham, and Sarah Reeves, the series delivers a powerful, immersive experience that leaves viewers asking: Do you believe?
